adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the spread condition for setting `slug` on organization creation changes from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which inverts when `slug` is written. The diff also keeps `requestedSlug` gated on `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED`, so on team-billing deployments it will now set both `slug` and `requestedSlug` immediately (previously only `requestedSlug`), and on non-team-billing deployments it will no longer set `slug` at creation (previously it did). This is a concrete behavioral change consistent with the finding.
